catalog.name: IWMI Animated Time Series (WMS)
catalog.description: Time-enabled layers served by datacube-ows over the IWMI Data Cube index. Unlike the COG layers in "IWMI Time Series", these carry a WMS TIME dimension, so TerriaJS puts them on the timeline and can animate them — press play in the bottom dock. Rendering and colour ramps are applied server-side by OWS; the legend comes from GetLegendGraphic.

members.name: Limpopo monthly actual ET — animated (2018–2026)
members.description: Monthly WaPOR actual evapotranspiration and interception for the Limpopo basin, 101 monthly time steps. Values are the raw WaPOR `L2_AETI_M` band, which is stored at 0.1 mm/month scaling — the legend is labelled accordingly, so read 1000 on the ramp as roughly 100 mm/month. Confirm the scale factor with IWMI before quoting absolute ET.

info.name: How this differs from the COG layers
info.content: The same rasters also appear under "IWMI Time Series" as one COG layer per month. Those cannot animate: TerriaJS's `cog` type has no time support. This layer is the same data served through WMS with a TIME dimension, which is what the timeline can drive.

info.name: Source
info.content: Product `et_monthly_limpopo` in the IWMI Data Cube, served by datacube-ows. https://explorer-production-0070.up.railway.app/products/et_monthly_limpopo

members.name: Africa annual flood occurrence — animated (2001–2024)
members.description: Annual flood occurrence across Africa at about 500 m, 24 annual time steps. Counts of flood detections within the year; the rasters are extremely sparse by design (only cells where flooding was detected carry a value), so expect scattered pixels rather than continuous coverage. The value's meaning is inferred from its distribution, not documented by the publisher.

info.name: Caveat
info.content: The per-year maximum is not fixed (17 in 2001, 37 in 2020), so the ramp is pinned to 37 to keep years comparable. Do not report a value as an established count of floods.

members.name: Limpopo rainfall anomaly — animated (ENSO forecast)
members.description: Monthly rainfall anomaly from the Limpopo ENSO briefing, 12 forecast months. Brown is drier than normal, teal wetter. This is a coarse 1-degree forecast grid (12x8 cells over the basin), not an observation product — it will look blocky, which is honest to its resolution.

members.name: Limpopo temperature anomaly — animated (ENSO forecast)
members.description: Monthly temperature anomaly from the Limpopo ENSO briefing, 12 forecast months. Blue is cooler than normal, red warmer. Same coarse 1-degree forecast grid as the rainfall anomaly.
